package.name: realsense2_camera_msgs
package.description:
Local declarations of the RealSense driver's Metadata and DeviceInfo interfaces.
The official `ros-jazzy-realsense2-camera-msgs` requires `ros2-distro-mutex >=0.16`, which cannot coexist with this workspace's pinned `mujoco-python 3.10.0` in the default environment. ROS 2 matches subscriptions by type identity, which is derived from the interface definition, so declaring the same definition locally lets the schema-v1 collector and camera monitor validate metadata and device identity without importing the driver's native ABI. The definitions match upstream 4.58.3; the driver itself still runs only in the isolated `cameras` environment.
